minutes.headline: Zoning board granted a special permit letting Massive Motors sublease its main building, and approved a home addition.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard an amendment to a 1983 special permit for Massive Motors at 381 Mass Ave, to allow part of the main building to be sublet. It then heard a continued request from William Tapley at 146 Lancaster Avenue for a dimensional variation for a home addition on a revised plan. Both were moved and seconded, and the chair read the standard permit conditions, then the board adjourned.

votes.motion: Approve the amended special permit allowing the main building at 381 Mass Ave to be sublet, same conditions as previously agreed other than condition seven
Grant the special permit for dimensional variation for side yard setback and height for the Tapley addition, based on the plan submitted 3/22/2019

decisions.decision: Board agreed no new conditions beyond the previous ones, other than condition seven, for the Massive Motors amendment.

The board took up an amendment to a 1983 special permit letting part of the Massive Motors main building at 381 Mass Ave be sublet; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The board agreed to add no new conditions to the Massive Motors permit beyond the earlier ones, other than condition seven.
The chair announced the Tapley permit granted and read the standard conditions before the board adjourned.
